title: TerrainActor
description: An external job-performer role in a customer workflow. This is NOT an internal org role (see CONSTELLATION). It describes who performs work in the real world before our solution exists.

role.description: Precise role title as used in the domain. Prefer specificity: 'Accounts Payable Clerk at a 3PL' over 'business user'.

organizationType.description: Type of organization this actor works within. e.g. 'energy retrofitter', 'industrial grid-flexibility participant', 'B2B buyer'.

responsibility.description: What this actor is responsible for in their context.

context.description: Relevant circumstance or environment. e.g. 'Month-end reporting', 'Post-retrofit payment settlement'.

authority.description: Decision authority this actor holds relevant to the workflow.

relatedActorIds.description: Other actors in adjacent or connected roles.
